content: {"episode_id": "ep-05126", "cpt": "93247", "denial_carc": "CO-22", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that have persisted despite initial rate control therapy for known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
